```yaml
name: Clean Unused Strings
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  clean-unused-strings:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r Tools/requirements.txt

      - name: Detect Unused Strings
        id: detect
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py
          echo "unused_count=$(cat /tmp/unused_count.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Remove Unused Strings
        if: env.unused_count != '0'
        run: |
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py

      - name: Generate Strings.swift
        if: env.unused_count != '0'
        run: |
          swiftgen --config Tools/swiftgen.yml

      - name: Commit Changes
        if: env.unused_count != '0'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: remove unused localization strings" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.unused_count != '0'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: remove unused localization strings"
          branch: "cleanup/unused-strings"
          delete-branch: true
          title: "Cleanup: Remove unused localization strings"
          body: |
            This PR removes unused localization strings detected by the automated cleanup workflow.
            
            ### Changes
            - Removed unused strings from all localization files
            - Regenerated Strings.swift with SwiftGen
            
            ### Automated Cleanup
            This PR was automatically generated by the clean-unused-strings workflow.
            
            Fixes: #<issue-number-if-applicable>
```
